headline: 2 female athletes banned for life and medals stripped after being proven male
summary: The Bangladesh Athletics Federation has taken strict action against Jannat Begum and Kobita Roy following a medical board report.
details: The Bangladesh Athletics Federation has stripped all medals and imposed a lifetime ban on national athletes Jannat Begum, 28, and Kobita Roy, 19, after they were proven to be male.
caption:

headline: Severe gas crisis brings daily life to a standstill in Bangladesh
summary: Long queues of vehicles at filling stations as drivers face immense suffering due to fuel shortages.
details: A severe gas crisis has brought daily life to a standstill across the country, causing widespread disruption to transport and essential services.
Filling stations are seeing long queues of vehicles, with drivers reporting significant hardship as they struggle to secure fuel.
The shortage has impacted various modes of transport, including CNG-run auto-rickshaws and private cars, leading to traffic congestion and delays.
Citizens are expressing frustration over the fuel scarcity, which has hampered their daily commute and affected business activities.
caption:
Daily life comes to a standstill. Long queues at filling stations as a severe gas crisis hits.

A severe gas crisis has brought daily life to a standstill across the country, causing widespread disruption to transport and essential services.

Citizens are expressing frustration over the fuel scarcity, which has hampered their daily commute and affected business activities.
